name: Mother Tree Sanctuary — surface and detail kit
prompt:
Create ONE clean detailed GAME ASSET REFERENCE SHEET, NOT Blender or a3Dmodel. Plain light ivory studio background, soft even light, full uncropped separate objects, readable thickness, precise non-melting forms. FULL IDs and names outside silhouettes, dimensions marked PROPOSED. Each cell independent illustration scale. No environment scenery, humans, extra unlabeled objects, watermark or whole-palace redesign. Use ONLY the single supplied source image for visible style/material/form authority; infer missing backs and assembly interfaces conservatively. Source illustration motifs are inspiration, not recovered measured geometry. Visible source facts: Huge pink-blossom living tree with root-formed Gothic gateway/cloister, trunk windows and small branch/roof niches, dangling wish charms and integrated flower planting. Living wood supplies architecture; source is not a masonry castle covered by a tree. Hidden layout inference: A shaded root courtyard receives the forest path, a broad root arch leads to a quiet wish clearing, and one gentle loop follows exterior root alcoves. Higher trunk balconies can remain visual or connect through a declared route, not assumed navigable from artwork. Preserve hero canopy and rooted lower openings. Preserve this local design. Exactly12 isolated main components in a clean4-column grid. No missing/empty slots or repeated subjects counted twice. One clear front/three-quarter view with useful small rear/top/contact inset per cell. Truly flat backs for appliques, square join ends for repeat mouldings. Screens have repeated coherent holes, no tangled tendrils. Windows separate glass from surrounds, cornices/parapets and posts separate where named. Do not include large room/scenery fragments attached to a tiny detail. Title "B18-DETAIL-001 — Mother Tree Sanctuary — surface and detail kit". Footer "Proposed construction / source-compatible references / mesh joins and views unverified".

Purpose/gap: Existing GEN-08/23 tree/charm vocabulary needs identity matching before reuse. Need root gateway floor/seats, trunk-window reveal and branch-balcony contact/guard geometry where unseen. Low shade planting, blossom petals and occasional deer/butterflies; no replacement by ordinary 18m forest oak. Missing detached construction pieces and local interior-facing patterns.
